detail.longDescription: If you're building a product that connects to your users' apps, you've probably run into the same problem: every integration is its own little project. You need to manage OAuth flows, token refresh, API quirks, and all the maintenance in between. Multiply that by dozens of apps, and your roadmap disappears.
